scientific_integrity: The theorem concerns orthogonal projections; the exact complementary norm gap, the general Fourier Green-kernel method and related lattice asymptotics are prior work. The claimed addition is the sharp logarithmic coefficient and bounded remainder.
scientific_limitations: No convergence or constant is asserted for the bounded remainder.
Other tori and weighted variants are not covered.
Unindexed equivalent derivations are possible; independent audit is not performed.
title: Sharp \(4/\pi\) logarithmic endpoint norm for square-torus Hodge projections
